text:
maya: scan-bot posted a DAST result for PR #8421, looks like an auth bypass on /internal/debug in staging. tagging @chris and @leo. :eyes:
chris: link? can you paste the failing request/response?
maya: https://git.redwood/pr/8421 and the scan snippet below:
```
> GET /internal/debug 200 OK
> Set-Cookie: session=; HttpOnly
> X-Auth-User: anonymous
```
maya: scanner shows it as HIGH because it returns sensitive telemetry in body.
anya: quick triage — on staging we patched ingress to allow health checks from 10.4.0.0/22 yesterday, that rule accidentally also lets a proxied path skip auth. not repro in prod.
leo: that matches a config change I landed in deploy 8f3a2b1 — removed an explicit auth check for /debug to speed up local dev. oops.
chris: can we confirm whether the KMS-wrapped artifact was involved? we need audit logs for the key used to sign the build. which key did CI use?
maya: CI used kms-key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ci-build-key. please pull access logs for that key and the KMS decrypt events around 2026-03-20T23:00Z.
leo: command to pull logs (gcloud):
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt\" AND timestamp>\"2026-03-20T22:40:00Z\"" --limit 50
```
anya: I've started a quick JIRA: INFSEC-2198 "staging /internal/debug auth bypass (DAST high)". adding steps to reproduce, vuln repro curl, and scan output. assigning to @chris for fix and to @maya for evidence.
scan-bot: DAST nightly run 2026-03-21T01:23Z for PR#8421: 1 HIGH (exposed telemetry), 2 MED, 4 LOW. Full artifact: https://scans.redwood/2026/03/21/8421.json
chris: thanks. I'll patch the route to enforce auth and add an explicit test in the premerge SAST/DAST harness. also will add an RBAC unit test to catch dev flags that disable auth.
maya: please attach KMS audit logs to the ticket — product security needs provenance proof that the same build artifact was used in staging. we should also record an audit entry in the keystore change log noting the temporary rule change.
leo: filed infra change note: infra-notes/2026-03-20-debug-exception.md and linked the deploy id.
anya: quick decision: not a release blocker (no prod exposure), but high severity for staging telemetry. I'm adding "mitigation checklist" to the ticket: rollback auth change, add SAST rule, add DAST regression test, attach KMS logs, and notify oncall for 24h monitoring.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation updated: maya -> leo (24h watch) — reminder set.
chris: I'll open a PR with the fix and reference INFSEC-2198. tagging @anya for test coverage.
maya: thanks all. once PR is merged, I'll mark the ticket "mitigated" and we can close after 24h without additional alerts. :white_check_mark:
anya: adding a postmortem note template to the ticket for root cause (dev auth exception + missing premerge DAST check).
leo: 👍
scan-bot: evidence bundle attached to INFSEC-2198: logs + curl repro + raw DAST findings.
maya: leaving follow-up tasks: (1) add RBAC premerge gating in CI (2) add KMS audit alert for unusual decrypts (3) ensure /internal/* endpoints are behind auth by default.
chris: ack, will handle (1) and (3).
anya: ack on (2) — I'll create an alert runbook.
maya: closing thread here but watching the ticket.
